sections.title: Talking about an area
sections.content: Use *hay* with the names of places to say what an area has. You know *hay* from Unit 9 and the articles from Unit 3, so you only need the new place names.

items.spanish: En mi barrio hay una plaza.
items.english: There is a square in my neighbourhood.

items.spanish: Hay un museo y una biblioteca.
items.english: There is a museum and a library.

sections.content: *En* means in. *En* mi *barrio* *hay*... is a useful pattern for describing your neighbourhood.
